transcript: I preserve my integrity by not over explaining myself. You get what I give you and not what you try to pull out of me. I am consistent in my communication. I am consistent in my behaviors. I plant myself like a tree in every situation. You cannot move and you cannot shake me. Nuance and context is everything. I do not try to diagnose anyone. I do not try to diagnose any situations. The present moment is what it is. I am not adding extra fluff into it.
